entries.title: Shared/Core update: sponsored-skill-layer2

ai.title: Add verify checks to Layer 2 sponsored skill schema
ai.summary: The Layer 2 sponsored skill schema in `common/src/ads/sponsored-skill-layer2.ts` now accepts an optional `verify` array, limited to `LAYER2_MAX_VERIFY` items, where each entry defines a case-insensitive regex check against source files. In `compileLayer2Skill`, these entries become `file_contains` checks that run before package and environment checks, allowing advertisers to prove that specific integration code (such as SDK imports) exists in the project. The instruction template for the agent step was also updated to frame these as guidelines the agent adapts rather than a rigid script, ensuring the wording never reads as user work.
ai.evidence: The diff introduces `LAYER2_MAX_VERIFY` and `layer2Verify` schema in `common/src/ads/sponsored-skill-layer2.ts`, adding a `verify` array to `sponsoredSkillLayer2Schema` that maps to `file_contains` checks on `SOURCE_FILES` within `compileLayer2Skill`.
ai.unknowns: The diff does not show which specific advertiser campaigns or skill definitions currently use the new verify field.

eli5.text: Advertisers buying sponsored tasks can now add up to three extra checks that confirm the code changes landed in a project, such as verifying a specific library import appears in the files. These checks run before other automatic verifications, giving the campaign stronger proof that the integration was completed correctly. The instructions given to the AI assistant also now frame the work as adaptable guidelines rather than a rigid script. This is an internal update to how sponsored campaigns are built and does not change what you see or do when using the assistant.
